product.name: QQQ
product.tagline: Metadata-driven application framework for building business software in Java.
product.summary: QQQ (by QRunIO) defines tables, fields, relationships, apps and processes in Java metadata and serves them through a metadata-driven dashboard, REST API, CLI and Lambda handlers from the same codebase. The stable release is QQQ 4.0.0 (GA, 2026-09-24, Apache-2.0, on Maven Central); 4.1 is in release candidates. qRun hosting, qStudio and production qBits are previews or planned.
product.readinessNotes: Ready for adoption marketing of the framework (4.0.0 GA). Present 4.1 as a release candidate and qRun / qStudio / production qBits as previews or planned. Open discrepancies: the website's share titles still say "QQQ 4.0 Preview" and its framework card says "release candidate" while GitHub marks 4.0.0 GA; fix before campaigns. Maven Central's latest/release fields point at an RC.
product.platforms: Java 21 (JDK 21+). 4.0 quickstart: macOS, Linux or Windows WSL with Bash, Docker, Git, curl, unzip.
product.adoptionPath: From https://www.qrun.io/try: install Java 21 JDK, Git, curl, unzip, Bash and a running Docker daemon; download quickstart.sh from the signed tag quickstart-4.0.0; run bash quickstart.sh (it builds the sample against QQQ 4.0.0 and starts the Next dashboard preview); open http://localhost:3000/app/person (mock auth, synthetic data); edit the Java under qqq-sample-project and re-run. For your own app, import com.kingsrook.qqq:qqq-bom-pom:4.0.0.
product.valuePropositions: Define tables, fields, relationships, apps and processes in Java instead of hand-writing table views, forms, CRUD, permissions, reports and scheduled jobs (README). Self-hosted, Apache-2.0, published on Maven Central without GitHub Packages credentials.

product.name: gclo
product.tagline: Clone an entire GitHub organization. Keep it up to date. In parallel.
product.summary: gclo (Git Clone Large Organizations) mirrors every repository of a GitHub organization or user account into a local folder in one pass: it clones what is missing and fast-forwards what exists, with live per-repo progress and bounded parallelism. It ships as a Windows 11 desktop app (WinUI 3) and a scriptable CLI on the same engine. MIT licensed.
product.readinessNotes: Ready for adoption marketing on Windows 11 x64 only (GitHub Releases: Setup, Portable, CLI zip; Scoop). Do not advertise winget (PR #450621 open), Chocolatey (1.0.1 unapproved), Homebrew, macOS or Linux binaries. Young product: two stable releases; 1.0.1 was a pulled crash release.
product.platforms: Windows 11 x64 (desktop app and self-contained CLI). The CLI builds from source on Linux/macOS with the .NET 10 SDK; no non-Windows binaries are published.
product.adoptionPath: Create a GitHub token (classic repo scope, optionally read:org; or fine-grained repo read). GUI: run gclo-stable-Setup.exe from Releases (per-user, no admin) or the portable zip; paste the token, pick the org, choose a folder, set parallelism, Load repos, Sync selected. CLI: unzip gclo-cli-win-x64-<version>.zip or scoop install gclo, set GITHUB_TOKEN, run gclo sync --org <name> --target <folder>.
product.valuePropositions: One pass clones the missing repositories and fast-forwards the existing ones, in parallel, with per-repo failure isolation; tokens stay in Windows Credential Manager; the CLI scripts the same engine.
